shots.content: Inside a seminar room, a rectangular worktable stands between a pinboard and the entrance, with windows along one side; a clear aisle runs opposite the window. There is one empty place. A man in an orange shirt sits at the entrance-side window seat and explains that every detail of the account must be examined. A man in a blue shirt sits at the pinboard-end seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the entrance end, looking along the worktable toward the pinboard, with both window-side seats and the pinboard-end seat and the pinboard in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt enters and sits in the empty place. A man in an orange shirt asks to restart the account from the beginning.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt asks to review all the evidence.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person at the entrance-side window seat.

shots.content: A man in an orange shirt asks to evaluate the narrative.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the worktable.
